item.title: Industry Expert Saisuman Singamsetty Delivers Guest Lecture on Data Engineering and Governance at Malla Reddy University
item.description: Strong data engineering practices—supported by governance frameworks, quality controls, and ethical safeguards—are what ensure reliability, scalability, and responsible use in real-world deployments

item.title: Hrithik Roshan's birthday party: Ex-wife Sussanne Khan, GF Saba Azad bond; fans call it non-Indian vibe
item.description: A few days after Hrithik Roshan's birthday, Sussanne Khan shared a heartfelt video collage to wish the star. The video featured their sons, along with Hrithik's partner Saba Azad and Sussanne's partner Arsalan Goni. Hrithik also shared a post thanking fans and celebrities for their birthday wishes. Meanwhile, Saba Azad posted cosy moments from their relationship and wrote, "Nothing in the world makes me happier than seeing you happy."

item.title: Cold wave grips Jammu; city turns colder than Gulmarg, Pahalgam
item.description: Jammu city recorded an unusually cold day, emerging as the coldest place in the Union Territory with a maximum temperature of 7.4°C, even lower than Gulmarg and Pahalgam.

item.title: Maha local polls: Technical glitches affect polling at several places; Minister goes booth hunting for one hour
item.description: Similar problems were reported across cities including Mumbai, Solapur, Pune, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, and Pimpri-Chinchwad, causing long delays and confusion among voters. In several areas, EVMs failed to start on time, and changes in booth assignments left citizens wandering in search of their designated polling centres. Public frustration is mounting over the State Election Commission's handling of the process.

item.title: Indian stock markets remain closed for Maharashtra civic elections
item.description: The decision follows the Maharashtra government's declaration of a public holiday on January 15 to ensure the smooth conduct of elections in 29 municipal corporations, including the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) in Mumbai.

item.title: US funding bill proposes to withhold Pakistan aid over Afridi case
item.description: The bill also prohibits any US assistance to the Taliban and includes human rights measures, such as applying visa restrictions on Chinese officials involved in violations against Tibetans. The legislation forms part of a broader package funding US government operations through September 30, 2026, covering national security, diplomatic missions, and foreign aid programs.

item.title: US lawmakers urge Trump admin to exempt doctors from H-1B fee
item.description: Lawmakers highlighted severe shortages in physicians, nurses, pediatric specialists, and other healthcare workers, citing data projecting the need for tens of thousands more medical professionals by 2037. They emphasized that H-1B workers do not displace US employees but are essential to sustaining the healthcare system.

item.title: Delhi-NCR shivers as cold wave intensifies; AQI 'very poor' in several areas
item.description: The India Meteorological Department has issued a yellow alert, warning of cold wave conditions and persistent fog, with temperatures dipping as low as 3–5 degrees Celsius. Dense fog has reduced visibility to near-zero levels in some areas, leading to possible flight delays at Delhi airport, where operations are continuing under CAT III conditions.

item.title: 'If you want progress, clean air in Mumbai, take responsibility': Hema Malini urges Mumbaikars to vote
item.description: A senior citizen raised concerns over chaos and delays at a polling booth during the Maharashtra local body elections, voicing his frustration directly to actress-politician Hema Malini after waiting nearly two hours to cast his vote. He said the lack of accountability made the experience particularly difficult for elderly voters. Hema Malini later appealed to Mumbai residents to exercise their right to vote,

item.title: Trump reverses nutrition rules, restores whole milk in schools; slaps 25% tariff on select semiconductor imports
item.description: US President Donald Trump has signed the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act, reversing school nutrition rules to allow whole milk back in US cafeterias and removing the requirement for a doctor's note for milk substitutes.mp also announced new Section 232 trade actions targeting critical minerals and semiconductor imports, including a 25 per cent tariff on select chips.
